arguments.value: Thomas Selby Ellis III served as a United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Virginia from 1987 until assuming senior status in 2007, continuing in that capacity until his death in 2025. Born in Bogotá, Colombia, and educated at Princeton University, Harvard Law School, and the University of Oxford, he began his career in the U.S. Navy before entering private practice in Richmond, Virginia. Nominated by President Ronald Reagan and confirmed by the Senate in 1987, Judge Ellis was widely respected for his long federal judicial service and also taught as a lecturer in law at the College of William and Mary.
